operations.label: save stable environment
operations.code:
import mod.server.extraServerApi as api
import json,sys
factory=api.GetEngineCompFactory()
level=api.GetLevelId()
clock=factory.CreateTime(level)
game=factory.CreateGame(level)
weather=factory.CreateWeather(level)
saved={'time':clock.GetTime(),'rules':game.GetGameRulesInfoServer()['cheat_info'],
 'raining':weather.IsRaining(),'thunder':weather.IsThunder()}
assert not hasattr(sys,'_context_environment_saved')
sys._context_environment_saved=saved
assert game.SetGameRulesInfoServer({'cheat_info':{'daylight_cycle':False,'weather_cycle':False}})
assert clock.SetTime((saved['time']//24000)*24000+6000)
assert weather.SetRaining(0.,200000) and weather.SetThunder(0.,200000)
_result=json.dumps(saved)

operations.label: prepare native air region
operations.code:
import json,math,sys
import mod.server.extraServerApi as api
assert not hasattr(sys,'_liquid_pose_world')
factory=api.GetEngineCompFactory()
player=api.GetPlayerList()[0]
dimension=factory.CreateDimension(player).GetEntityDimensionId()
assert dimension==0
foot=factory.CreatePos(player).GetFootPos()
origin=(int(math.floor(foot[0]))+6,min(int(math.floor(foot[1]))+24,300),int(math.floor(foot[2]))+6)
info=factory.CreateBlockInfo(player)
region=[(origin[0]+x,origin[1]+y,origin[2]+z) for x in range(-2,4) for y in range(-2,4) for z in range(-2,4)]
for pos in region:
 front=info.GetBlockNew(pos,dimension)
 back=info.GetLiquidBlock(pos,dimension)
 assert front and front.get('name')=='minecraft:air',(pos,front)
 assert back is None or back.get('name')=='minecraft:air',(pos,back)
sys._liquid_pose_world={'origin':origin,'region':region,'player':player,'dimension':dimension,'foot_before':foot}
assert info.SetBlockNew(origin,{'name':'minecraft:cyan_concrete','aux':0},0,dimension,True,False)
_result=json.dumps({'origin':origin,'player':player,'dimension':dimension,'region':region,
 'placed':info.GetBlockNew(origin,dimension),'nbt':info.GetBlockEntityData(dimension,origin)})

operations.code:
import json,sys
import mod.server.extraServerApi as api
saved=sys._liquid_pose_world
origin=tuple(saved['origin'])
platform=(origin[0]-4,origin[1]-1,origin[2]-4)
info=api.GetEngineCompFactory().CreateBlockInfo(saved['player'])
before=info.GetBlockNew(platform,saved['dimension'])
assert before and before.get('name')=='minecraft:air',(platform,before)
back=info.GetLiquidBlock(platform,saved['dimension'])
assert back is None or back.get('name')=='minecraft:air',(platform,back)
saved['region'].append(platform)
assert info.SetBlockNew(platform,{'name':'minecraft:stone','aux':0},0,saved['dimension'],True,False)
point=(platform[0]+.5,platform[1]+1.,platform[2]+.5)
assert api.GetEngineCompFactory().CreatePos(saved['player']).SetFootPos(point)
_result=json.dumps({'before':saved['foot_before'],'after':point,'platform':platform})

operations.label: single east unpowered empty lectern
operations.code:
import json,sys,copy
import mod.server.extraServerApi as api
saved=sys._liquid_pose_world
factory=api.GetEngineCompFactory()
info=factory.CreateBlockInfo(saved['player'])
dimension=saved['dimension']
origin=tuple(saved['origin'])
target=tuple(origin[axis]+(1,1,1)[axis] for axis in range(3))
for x in range(3):
 for y in range(3):
  for z in range(3):
   point=tuple(origin[axis]+(x,y,z)[axis] for axis in range(3))
   current=info.GetBlockNew(point,dimension)
   assert current is not None
   if current['name']!='minecraft:air':
    assert info.SetBlockNew(point,{'name':'minecraft:air','aux':0},0,dimension,True,False)
assert info.SetBlockNew((origin[0]+1,origin[1],origin[2]+1),{'name':'minecraft:cyan_concrete','aux':0},0,dimension,True,False)
assert info.SetBlockNew(target,{'name':'minecraft:lectern','aux':3},0,dimension,True,False)
items=factory.CreateItem(saved['player'])
kind=api.GetMinecraftEnum().ItemPosType.INVENTORY
saved['oracle_inventory_before']=[items.GetPlayerItem(kind,index,True) for index in range(36)]
saved['oracle_slot']=next((index for index in reversed(range(36)) if not saved['oracle_inventory_before'][index]),None)
assert saved['oracle_slot'] is not None
_result=True

operations.label: native authored A and real inventory insertion
operations.code:
import json,sys,copy
import mod.server.extraServerApi as api
saved=sys._liquid_pose_world
factory=api.GetEngineCompFactory()
info=factory.CreateBlockInfo(saved['player'])
dimension=saved['dimension']
origin=tuple(saved['origin'])
target=tuple(origin[axis]+(1,1,1)[axis] for axis in range(3))
from modern_projection.projection.nbt_spatial import root_payload,field_key,scalar
loot=factory.CreateLoot(saved['player']).GetLootItems('loot_tables/modern_projection/r21_signed_book.json','-1','-1',0.0,True)
assert len(loot)==2,loot
source=copy.deepcopy(loot[0])
submitted=copy.deepcopy(source)
submitted['itemName']=submitted.get('newItemName',submitted.get('itemName'))
submitted['auxValue']=submitted.get('newAuxValue',submitted.get('auxValue',0))
assert submitted['itemName']=='minecraft:written_book' and submitted['count']==1,submitted
tags=root_payload(submitted.get('userData')) or {}
assert scalar(tags,'title')=='R21 Book A',tags
native_pages=scalar(tags,'pages')
assert isinstance(native_pages,list) and len(native_pages)==2,tags
assert [scalar(root_payload(page) or {},'text') for page in native_pages]==['First authored control.','Second authored control.'],tags
assert scalar(tags,'author')=='R21 Native Loot',tags
assert field_key(tags,'pages') is not None,tags
items=factory.CreateItem(saved['player'])
kind=api.GetMinecraftEnum().ItemPosType.INVENTORY
slot=saved['oracle_slot']
assert items.SpawnItemToPlayerInv(submitted,saved['player'],slot)
actual=items.GetPlayerItem(kind,slot,True)
enchantments=items.GetInvItemEnchantData(slot)
assert actual.get('userData')==source.get('userData'),(actual,source)
assert not enchantments,enchantments
saved['oracle_actual_item']=copy.deepcopy(actual)
used=info.PlayerUseItemToPos(target,kind,slot,1)
remaining=items.GetPlayerItem(kind,slot,True)
assert used
_result=json.dumps({'native_loot_items':loot,'submitted_native_item':submitted,'actual_inventory_item':actual,
 'actual_enchantments':enchantments,'native_use_return':used,'inventory_after_use':remaining,
 'item_data_manufactured':False,'nbt_setter_used':False})

operations.code:
import json,sys,copy
import mod.server.extraServerApi as api
saved=sys._liquid_pose_world
factory=api.GetEngineCompFactory()
info=factory.CreateBlockInfo(saved['player'])
dimension=saved['dimension']
origin=tuple(saved['origin'])
target=tuple(origin[axis]+(1,1,1)[axis] for axis in range(3))
items=factory.CreateItem(saved['player'])
kind=api.GetMinecraftEnum().ItemPosType.INVENTORY
if 'oracle_slot' in saved:
 slot=saved['oracle_slot']
 current=items.GetPlayerItem(kind,slot,True)
 if current:assert items.SetInvItemNum(slot,0)
after=[items.GetPlayerItem(kind,index,True) for index in range(36)]
before=saved.get('oracle_inventory_before',after)
_result=json.dumps({'restored':after==before,'before':before,'after':after})

operations.label: world_restore
operations.code:
import json,sys
import mod.server.extraServerApi as api
saved=getattr(sys,'_liquid_pose_world',None)
rows=[]
if saved is not None:
 info=api.GetEngineCompFactory().CreateBlockInfo(saved['player'])
 assert api.GetEngineCompFactory().CreatePos(saved['player']).SetFootPos(tuple(saved['foot_before']))
 for pos in saved['region']:
  before=info.GetBlockNew(tuple(pos),saved['dimension'])
  if before.get('name')!='minecraft:air':
   assert info.SetBlockNew(tuple(pos),{'name':'minecraft:air','aux':0},0,saved['dimension'],True,False)
  after=info.GetBlockNew(tuple(pos),saved['dimension'])
  rows.append({'pos':pos,'after':after})
 assert all(row['after'].get('name')=='minecraft:air' for row in rows)
 del sys._liquid_pose_world
_result=json.dumps({'restored':True,'rows':rows})
